character.name: Sidonie Clodpole
character.description: A thin, anxious presence wrapped in a scarf of regulation length, carrying a bag that clinks in an administrative way. Sidonie is a Professional Mourner, Between Engagements and is keeping in practice and will be sad about anything, on request.

npc.narrative: You reach the ceppo at the Usual Place as the sera settles, clear and fresca. Sidonie sits on it in nero, with a small barattolo marked cappello and a lunga faccia. The first stelle arrive without a modulo.
npc.native: Buonasera! Sono Sidonie e oggi non lavoro, quindi sono felice. Risparmio per un cappello nuovo. E tu, come stai oggi?
npc.translation: Good evening! I am Sidonie and today I am not working, so I am happy. I am saving up for a new hat. And you, how are you today?

player: Buonasera Sidonie! Oggi sono molto felice, perché ho finito il lavoro presto e c'è un bel tramonto.

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer! You greeted Sidonie and told her you are very happy today, and you even gave reasons in good Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: "Oggi sono molto felice" tells Sidonie you are happy today.
You didn't ask Sidonie what is wrong yet; that will come up again later.
You didn't tell Sidonie that you understand or are sorry yet; that will come up again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Sidonie is staring into a cup of something that went cold a good while ago. Ask Sidonie what is wrong, using Italian.
Tell Sidonie that you understand, or that you are very sorry, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Il tramonto settles behind the piazza, and Sidonie watches it like a clerk checking a sum. In one hand is a small borsa that clinks the way a hat fund does when it is mostly hope. Sidonie looks at you a little too long, as if you were someone from a funeral in another province.
npc.native: Un tramonto e il lavoro finito: che fortuna! Io, invece, sono un po' triste. Il cappello costa troppo e non capisco che succede ai prezzi. Ma essere triste è il mio mestiere, quindi faccio pratica.
npc.translation: A sunset and the work finished: what luck! I, on the other hand, am a little sad. The hat costs too much and I do not understand what is happening to the prices. But being sad is my trade, so I am keeping in practice.

player: Oh no. Che cosa c'è che non va? Solo il cappello?

verdict.overallFeedback: You asked Sidonie what was wrong in good Italian, and you even followed up about the hat. Next, try showing her some sympathy.

objectiveResults.feedback: Passed: "Che cosa c'è che non va?" is a lovely way to ask Sidonie what is wrong.

vocabularyEvidence.evidence: Che cosa c'è che non va

objectiveResults.feedback: Not yet: this one wants you to tell Sidonie that you understand how she feels, or that you are very sorry. Sidonie will give you another chance to do it.

openObjectives.prompt: Tell Sidonie that you understand, or that you are very sorry, using Italian.

npc.narrative: The notte is quiet, and the stelle hang over the strada like a bill nobody has opened. Sidonie holds a vecchio cappello in both mani, sempre as if it were about to leave. Nearby, a gatto sits ancora on the muro.
npc.native: Grazie, sei gentile. Non è solo il cappello: questa settimana nessuno muore, e il mio lavoro è fermo. Parli piano, e così ti capisco bene, ma i soldi non arrivano lo stesso. E tu, come stai quando i soldi non bastano?
npc.translation: Thank you, you are kind. It is not only the hat: this week nobody dies, and my work is at a standstill. You speak slowly, and so I understand you well, but the money does not arrive all the same. And you, how are you when money is not enough?

player: Mi dispiace molto, ti capisco. Quando non ho soldi sono preoccupato, ma cerco di non pensarci. Forse la prossima settimana qualcuno... ehm, ha bisogno di te?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer! You comforted Sidonie, told her how you feel when money is short, and wished her some work next week, all in clear Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Passed: "Mi dispiace molto, ti capisco" tells Sidonie you are sorry and that you understand her.

npc.narrative: It is notte now, and the cielo is grey, with no stella willing to be counted. Sidonie holds a piccola borsa, the hat fund, and weighs it the way a mourner weighs a silence. It does not take long.
npc.native: Capisci tutto, e questo mi fa molto piacere. Anche io cerco di non pensarci, ma è difficile con un cappello così bello in vetrina. Speri che qualcuno abbia bisogno di me, e sei gentile, ma non voglio la tristezza di nessuno solo per un cappello. Che cosa fai tu la sera per non pensare ai problemi?
npc.translation: You understand everything, and that pleases me very much. I also try not to think about it, but it is hard with such a beautiful hat in the shop window. You hope someone needs me, and you are kind, but I do not want anyone's sadness just for a hat. What do you do in the evening so as not to think about problems?

player: Ok, ci provo. Ehm... il mio telefono è morto stamattina. È stato terribile! Sei triste per il mio telefono?

npc.narrative: La notte is grigia and low, and the tramonto you mentioned has been put away somewhere. Sidonie takes a nero fazzoletto from a manica, with the air of someone about to be professionally sorry.
npc.native: Sì, certo, sono triste per il tuo telefono. Non l'ho mai conosciuto, ma il lutto è il mio mestiere. Una volta ho pianto per un ponte, e il ponte era molto grato. Che cosa hai fatto stamattina, quando il telefono è morto?
npc.translation: Yes, of course, I am sad for your telephone. I never knew it, but mourning is my trade. Once I cried for a bridge, and the bridge was very grateful. What did you do this morning, when the telephone died?

player: Sì, l'ho perso tre volte! Una volta nel frigo. Grazie Sidonie, ora sto meglio. Buonanotte!

npc.narrative: You turn up your collar in the pioggia, which falls piano and with no great conviction. Sidonie waves from the porta of the bottega, purse in the other mano, counting the cappello fund di nuovo, which takes very poco time. Down the strada a lanterna makes a small, wet luce.
npc.native: Nel frigo! Forse il telefono aveva solo freddo, e io ho pianto per niente. Sono contenta che stai meglio. Buonanotte, e porta un ombrello: penso di conoscerti già, ma forse sbaglio.
npc.translation: In the fridge! Maybe the telephone was only cold, and I cried for nothing. I am glad you are feeling better. Goodnight, and take an umbrella: I think I know you already, but maybe I am wrong.
